```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(textdata)
library(tm)
library(caret)
library(stringr)
library(wordcloud)
library(widyr)
library(topicmodels)
library(rpart)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
library(arules)
library(arulesViz)
library(pROC)
library(cluster)


raw_data <- read_csv("journal_data_CW4.csv")
#nrow(raw_data)
raw_data <- distinct(raw_data)
#nrow(raw_data)
#row number doesn't change after selecting distinct rows so no need to re-number the docs

```


```{r}
#tokenize abstracts

tidy_data <- raw_data %>% 
  select(doc_number, journal, year, abstract) %>% 
  unnest_tokens(word, abstract) %>%
  filter(str_detect(word, "^[a-z]+$"))       #this was added after the initial pre-processing as it only became an issue in a later task, so is redefined a few time later'


#checking top words

#slice_head(tidy_data %>% 
#             count(word) %>% 
#             arrange(desc(n)), n = 10)

#load and exclude stop words

data("stop_words")

tidy_data <- tidy_data %>% 
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(word, "\\b\\d+\\b"))

slice_head(tidy_data %>% 
             count(word) %>% 
             arrange(desc(n)),n=20)

# custom stop words from inspection (justified in report)

custom_stop_words <- c("method", "methods","paper", "model","models",  "results", "based", "proposed", "study", "approach","analysis","data")

tidy_data <- tidy_data %>% 
  filter(!word %in% custom_stop_words)

slice_head(tidy_data %>% 
             count(word) %>% 
             arrange(desc(n)),n=20)


```



```{r}
#word cloud
top_words <- tidy_data %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 40)

with(top_words,
     wordcloud(word, n, random.order = FALSE, scale = c(3, 0.8))
)

```


```{r}
# word pairs

top_words <- tidy_data %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50) %>%
  pull(word)

pairs <- tidy_data %>%
  filter(word %in% top_words) %>%
  pairwise_count(item = word, feature = doc_number, sort = TRUE)

pairs %>%
  slice_head(n = 25) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(paste(item1, item2, sep=" - "), n))) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Most common word pairs",
    x = "Number of documents containing both words",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
```{r}

#word freq by journal

top_words_journal <- tidy_data %>% 
  count(journal, word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(journal) %>% 
  slice_max(n, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%

top_words_journal %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder_within(word, n, journal))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ journal, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 most frequent words by journal",
    x = "Word frequency",
    y = NULL
  )
top_words_journal
```

```{r}
#LDA topic modeling

abstract_words <- tidy_data %>%
  count(doc_number, word, sort = TRUE)

abstract_dtm <- abstract_words %>%
  cast_dtm(doc_number, word, n)

abstract_lda <- LDA(abstract_dtm, k = 5, control = list(seed = 10))
abstract_topics <- tidy(abstract_lda, matrix = "beta")
abstract_gamma <- tidy(abstract_lda, matrix = "gamma")


top_terms <- abstract_topics %>%
  group_by(topic) %>%
  slice_max(beta, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(term = reorder_within(term, beta, topic))

ggplot(top_terms, aes(x = term, y = beta, fill = factor(topic))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  labs(
    title = "Top terms per topic (LDA)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Beta"
    + theme(
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 20, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10))
  ) 
```

```{r}
#classification

#setup train/test sets

labels <- raw_data %>% 
  select(doc_number, journal) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    doc_number = as.integer(doc_number), 
    journal = as.factor(journal)
  )

set.seed(10)
idx_train <- createDataPartition(labels$journal, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

train_ids <- labels$doc_number[idx_train]
test_ids <- labels$doc_number[-idx_train]

y_train <- labels$journal[idx_train]
y_test <- labels$journal[-idx_train]
```

```{r}
#BOW classification

max_words <- 1500

selected_words <- tidy_data %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = max_words) %>%
  pull(word)

X_sparse <- tidy_data %>%
  filter(word %in% selected_words) %>%
  count(doc_number, word) %>%
  cast_sparse(doc_number, word, n)

train_rows <- as.character(train_ids)
test_rows <- as.character(test_ids)

X_bow_train <- as.matrix(X_sparse[train_rows, , drop = FALSE])
X_bow_test <- as.matrix(X_sparse[test_rows, , drop = FALSE])

colnames(X_bow_train) <- make.names(colnames(X_bow_train))
colnames(X_bow_test) <- make.names(colnames(X_bow_test))

bow_trainset <- data.frame(journal = y_train, X_bow_train)
bow_test_x <- data.frame(X_bow_test)

pred_cols <- setdiff(names(bow_trainset), "journal")
missing_cols <- setdiff(pred_cols, names(bow_test_x))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  bow_test_x[missing_cols] <- 0
}

bow_test_x <- bow_test_x[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
#random forest -BOW
set.seed(10)

bow_rf <- randomForest(
  journal ~ .,
  data = bow_trainset,
  ntree = 100,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(X_bow_train)))
)

pred_bow_rf <- predict(bow_rf, newdata = bow_test_x)
cm_bow_rf <- confusionMatrix(pred_bow_rf, y_test)
cm_bow_rf

```
```{r}
#XGboost - BOW

pred_cols <- setdiff(names(bow_trainset), "journal")

missing_cols <- setdiff(pred_cols, names(bow_test_x))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) bow_test_x[missing_cols] <- 0
bow_test_x <- bow_test_x[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE]

xg_train <- as.matrix(bow_trainset[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE])
xg_test <- as.matrix(bow_test_x)

xg_train_label <- as.integer(y_train) - 1
xg_test_label <- as.integer(y_test) - 1

set.seed(10)

bow_xg <- xgboost(
  data = xg_train, 
  label = xg_train_label,
  max.depth = 3,
  nrounds = 300,
  eta = 0.3,
  objective = "multi:softmax",
  num_class = length(levels(y_train)),
  verbose = 0
)

pred_bow_xg <- predict(bow_xg, xg_test)
pred_bow_xg <- factor(
  levels(y_train)[pred_bow_xg + 1],
  levels = levels(y_train)
)

cm_bow_xg <- confusionMatrix(pred_bow_xg, y_test)
cm_bow_xg
```

```{r}
#XGboost - tf-idf

set.seed(10)

tf_idf_xg <- xgboost(
  data = xg_train, 
  label = train_label,
  max.depth = 3,
  nrounds = 300,
  eta = 0.3,
  objective = "multi:softmax",
  num_class = length(levels(y_train)),
  verbose = 0
)

pred_tf_idf_xg <- predict(tf_idf_xg, xg_test)
pred_tf_idf_xg <- factor(
  levels(y_train)[pred_tf_idf_xg + 1],

)

cm_tf_idf_xg <- confusionMatrix(pred_tf_idf_xg, y_test)
cm_tf_idf_xg
```

```{r}
#XGboost - topic distribution

X_topic <- abstract_gamma %>%
  mutate(
    document = as.integer(document),
    topic = paste0("topic_", topic)
  ) %>%
  select(document, topic, gamma) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = topic, values_from = gamma, values_fill = 0) %>%
  rename(doc_number = document)

X_topic_train <- X_topic %>%
  filter(doc_number %in% train_ids) %>%
  arrange(doc_number) %>%
  select(-doc_number)

X_topic_test <- X_topic %>%
  filter(doc_number %in% test_ids) %>%
  arrange(doc_number) %>%
  select(-doc_number)

xg_train <- as.matrix(X_topic_train)
xg_test <- as.matrix(X_topic_test)

train_label <- as.integer(y_train) - 1

set.seed(10)

topic_xg <- xgboost(
  data = xg_train, 
  label = train_label,
  max.depth = 3,
  nrounds = 500,
  eta = 0.2,
  objective = "multi:softmax",
  num_class = length(levels(y_train)),
  verbose = 0
)

pred_topic_xg <- predict(topic_xg, xg_test)
pred_topic_xg <- factor(
  levels(y_train)[pred_topic_xg + 1], 
  levels = levels(y_train)
)

cm_topic_xg <- confusionMatrix(pred_topic_xg, y_test)
cm_topic_xg
```

```{r}
# association

#transactions per journal

min_freq <- 25

journals <- raw_data %>%
  distinct(journal) %>%
  arrange(journal) %>%
  pull(journal)

tokens_list <- vector("list", length(journals))
transactions_list <- vector("list", length(journals))

for (j in seq_along(journals)) {

  tokens <- raw_data %>%
    filter(journal == journals[j]) %>%
    select(doc_number, abstract) %>%
    mutate(doc_number = as.integer(doc_number)) %>%
    unnest_tokens(word, abstract) %>%
    anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
    filter(!word %in% custom_stop_words) %>%
    filter(str_detect(word, "^[a-z]+$")) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(word, "\\b\\d+\\b"))

  keep_words <- tokens %>%
    count(word) %>%
    filter(n >= min_freq) %>%
    pull(word)

  tokens <- tokens %>%
    filter(word %in% keep_words)

  tokens_list[[j]] <- tokens

  transactions_list[[j]] <- tokens %>%
    distinct(doc_number, word) %>%
    split(.$doc_number) %>%
    lapply(function(x) x$word) %>%
    as("transactions")
}

summary_df <- tibble(
  journal = journals,
  n_docs = sapply(tokens_list, function(x) n_distinct(x$doc_number)),
  n_words = sapply(tokens_list, function(x) n_distinct(x$word)),
  n_transactions = sapply(transactions_list, length)
)

summary_df

```

```{r}
min_support <- 0.01
min_conf <- 0.4

rules_list <- vector("list", 4)

for (j in 1:4) {
  
  rules <- apriori(
    transactions_list[[j]],
    parameter = list(
      supp = min_support,
      conf = min_conf,
      minlen = 2
    )
  )
  
  rules <- subset(rules, lift > 1.0)
  rules <- sort(rules, by = "lift", decreasing = TRUE)
  
  rules_list[[j]] <- rules
}

rules_summary <- tibble(
  journal = 1:4,
  n_rules = sapply(rules_list, length)
)

rules_summary
```

```{r}
# visualisations

n_rules <- 15

for (j in 1:4) {

  rules_sorted <- sort(rules_list[[j]], by = "lift", decreasing = TRUE)
  rules_sub <- rules_sorted[1:min(n_rules, length(rules_sorted))]

  p <- plot(
    rules_sub,
    method  = "graph",
    measure = "lift",
    shading = "confidence"
  )

  # add title
  if (inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    print(p + ggplot2::ggtitle(
      paste("Journal", j, "- top", n_rules, "association rules")
    ))
  } else {
    title(
      main = paste("Journal", j, "- top", n_rules, "association rules"),
      cex.main = 0.9
    )
  }
}


```

```{r}
#hierarchical clustering - idf

year_tf_idf <- tidy_data %>%
  count(year, word) %>%
  bind_tf_idf(term = word, document = year, n = n) %>%
  select(year, word, tf_idf)

top_words_year <- year_tf_idf %>%
  group_by(word) %>%
  summarise(mean_tf_idf = mean(tf_idf)) %>%
  slice_max(mean_tf_idf, n = 500) %>%
  pull(word)

year_mat <- year_tf_idf %>%
  filter(word %in% top_words_year) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = word, values_from = tf_idf, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(year)

year_labels <- year_mat$year
X_year <- as.matrix(year_mat[, -1])
rownames(X_year) <- year_labels

d_year <- dist(X_year, method = "euclidean")
hc_year <- hclust(d_year, method = "ward.D2")

plot(hc_year, main = "Hierarchical clustering of years (TF-IDF, euclidean)")
```



```{r}
# pre vs post 2015 classification

labels_time <- raw_data %>%
  select(doc_number, year) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    doc_number = as.integer(doc_number),
    period = ifelse(year < 2015, "pre", "post"),
    period = as.factor(period)
  )

set.seed(10)
idx_train_time <- createDataPartition(labels_time$period, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

train_ids_time <- labels_time$doc_number[idx_train_time]
test_ids_time <- labels_time$doc_number[-idx_train_time]
y_train_time <- labels_time$period[idx_train_time]
y_test_time <- labels_time$period[-idx_train_time]

```

```{r}
tidy_time <- raw_data %>%
  select(doc_number, abstract) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, abstract) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  filter(!word %in% custom_stop_words) %>%
  filter(str_detect(word, "^[a-z]+$"))

max_words_time <- 1500

selected_words_time <- tidy_time %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = max_words_time) %>%
  pull(word)

```

```{r}
X_tf_idf_time <- tidy_time %>%
  filter(word %in% selected_words_time) %>%
  count(doc_number, word) %>%
  bind_tf_idf(term = word, document = doc_number, n = n) %>%
  select(doc_number, word, tf_idf) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = word, values_from = tf_idf, values_fill = 0)

docs_time <- tibble(doc_number = sort(unique(c(train_ids_time, test_ids_time))))

X_tf_idf_full <- docs_time %>%
  left_join(X_tf_idf_time, by = "doc_number") %>%
  mutate(across(-doc_number, ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  arrange(doc_number)

X_tf_train <- X_tf_idf_full %>%
  filter(doc_number %in% train_ids_time) %>%
  arrange(doc_number) %>%
  select(-doc_number)

X_tf_test <- X_tf_idf_full %>%
  filter(doc_number %in% test_ids_time) %>%
  arrange(doc_number) %>%
  select(-doc_number)

colnames(X_tf_train) <- make.names(colnames(X_tf_train))
colnames(X_tf_test) <- make.names(colnames(X_tf_test))

tf_trainset <- data.frame(period = y_train_time, X_tf_train)
tf_test_x <- data.frame(X_tf_test)

pred_cols <- setdiff(names(tf_trainset), "period")
missing_cols <- setdiff(pred_cols, names(tf_test_x))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  tf_test_x[missing_cols] <- 0
}

tf_test_x <- tf_test_x[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
#rf
set.seed(10)

tf_rf <- randomForest(
  period ~ .,
  data = tf_trainset,
  ntree = 200,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(X_tf_train)))
)

pred_tf_rf <- predict(tf_rf, newdata = tf_test_x)
cm_time_rf <- confusionMatrix(pred_tf_rf, y_test_time)
cm_time_rf
```

```{r}
#xgboost

y_train_xgb <- factor(y_train_time, levels = c("pre", "post"))
y_test_xgb <- factor(y_test_time, levels = c("pre", "post"))

xg_train <- as.matrix(X_tf_train)
xg_test <- as.matrix(X_tf_test)

train_label <- as.integer(y_train_xgb) - 1

tab <- table(y_train_xgb)
scale_pos <- as.numeric(tab["pre"] / tab["post"])

set.seed(10)

tf_xg <- xgboost(
  data = xg_train,
  label = train_label,
  max.depth = 4,
  nrounds = 400,
  eta = 0.2,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  scale_pos_weight = scale_pos,
  verbose = 0
)

pred_prob <- predict(tf_xg, xg_test)
pred_class <- ifelse(pred_prob > 0.5, "post", "pre")
pred_class <- factor(pred_class, levels = c("pre", "post"))

cm_time_xg <- confusionMatrix(pred_class, y_test_xgb, positive = "post")
cm_time_xg
```

```{r}
#association rules for year

time_map <- raw_data %>%
  select(doc_number, year) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    doc_number = as.integer(doc_number),
    period = ifelse(year < 2015, "pre", "post"),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("pre", "post"))
  )

tokens_time <- raw_data %>%
  select(doc_number, abstract) %>%
  mutate(doc_number = as.integer(doc_number)) %>%
  inner_join(time_map, by = "doc_number") %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, abstract) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  filter(!word %in% custom_stop_words) %>%
  filter(str_detect(word, "^[a-z]+$"))

min_freq_time <- 25

keep_words_time <- tokens_time %>%
  count(word) %>%
  filter(n >= min_freq_time) %>%
  pull(word)

tokens_time <- tokens_time %>%
  filter(word %in% keep_words_time)

transactions_by_period <- tokens_time %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  setNames(c("pre", "post")) %>%
  lapply(function(df) {
    df %>%
      distinct(doc_number, word) %>%
      split(.$doc_number) %>%
      lapply(function(x) x$word) %>%
      as("transactions")
  })

min_support <- 0.01
min_conf <- 0.4

rules_by_period <- lapply(transactions_by_period, function(tr) {
  r <- apriori(
    tr,
    parameter = list(
      supp = min_support,
      conf = min_conf,
      minlen = 2
    )
  )
  r <- subset(r, lift > 1.0)
  r <- sort(r, by = "lift", decreasing = TRUE)
  r
})

rules_summary_time <- tibble(
  period = names(rules_by_period),
  n_rules = sapply(rules_by_period, length)
)

rules_summary_time
```

```{r}
#cluster/pca

#setup

doc_meta <- raw_data %>%
  select(doc_number, year, journal) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(doc_number = as.integer(doc_number))

tidy_all <- raw_data %>%
  select(doc_number, abstract) %>%
  mutate(doc_number = as.integer(doc_number)) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, abstract) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  filter(!word %in% custom_stop_words) %>%
  filter(str_detect(word, "^[a-z]+$")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(word, "\\b\\d+\\b"))

max_words <- 1500

selected_words <- tidy_all %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = max_words) %>%
  pull(word)

tfidf_long <- tidy_all %>%
  filter(word %in% selected_words) %>%
  count(doc_number, word) %>%
  bind_tf_idf(term = word, document = doc_number, n = n) %>%
  select(doc_number, word, tf_idf)

doc_ids <- tfidf_long %>%
  distinct(doc_number) %>%
  arrange(doc_number) %>%
  pull(doc_number)

```

```{r}
#clusters
X_mat <- tfidf_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = word, values_from = tf_idf, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(doc_number) %>%
  select(-doc_number) %>%
  as.matrix()

colnames(X_mat) <- make.names(colnames(X_mat))
d_euc <- dist(X_mat, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(d_euc, method = "ward.D2")

k_grid <- 2:8

sil_df <- tibble(
  k = k_grid,
  avg_sil = sapply(k_grid, function(k) {
    cl <- cutree(hc, k = k)
    mean(silhouette(cl, d_euc)[, 3])
  })
)

k <- sil_df %>% slice_max(avg_sil, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(k)

clusters <- cutree(hc, k = k)

cluster_df <- tibble(
  doc_number = doc_ids,
  cluster = factor(clusters)
) %>%
  left_join(doc_meta, by = "doc_number")

cluster_df %>% count(cluster)

```

```{r}
# top words per cluster

tfidf_with_cluster <- tfidf_long %>%
  left_join(cluster_df %>% select(doc_number, cluster), by = "doc_number")

top_terms <- tfidf_with_cluster %>%
  group_by(cluster, word) %>%
  summarise(mean_tfidf = mean(tf_idf), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(mean_tfidf, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

top_terms %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(word, mean_tfidf), y = mean_tfidf)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 words per cluster (mean TF-IDF)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean TF-IDF"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

top_terms

```

```{r}
# PCA visualisation

pca <- prcomp(X_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

scores <- as_tibble(pca$x[, 1:2])
colnames(scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2")

scores <- scores %>%
  mutate(doc_number = doc_ids) %>%
  left_join(cluster_df, by = "doc_number")

#trimm outliers
pc1_q <- quantile(scores$PC1, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
pc2_q <- quantile(scores$PC2, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)

scores_trim <- scores %>%
  filter(
    PC1 >= pc1_q[1] & PC1 <= pc1_q[2],
    PC2 >= pc2_q[1] & PC2 <= pc2_q[2]
  )

ggplot(scores_trim, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA projection of TF-IDF documents (coloured by cluster)",
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#Regression - predict citations

reg_base <- raw_data %>%
  select(doc_number, journal, year, citations, altmetric, abstract) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    doc_number = as.integer(doc_number),
    journal = as.factor(journal),
    year = as.integer(year),
    citations = as.numeric(citations),
    altmetric = as.numeric(altmetric),
    abstract_length = str_count(abstract, "\\w+")
  ) %>%
  select(doc_number, journal, year, citations, altmetric, abstract_length)

#topic model
topic_wide <- abstract_gamma %>%
  mutate(
    doc_number = as.integer(document),
    topic = paste0("topic_", topic)
  ) %>%
  select(doc_number, topic, gamma) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = topic, values_from = gamma, values_fill = 0)

#tf-idf summary 
tidy_reg <- raw_data %>%
  select(doc_number, abstract) %>%
  mutate(doc_number = as.integer(doc_number)) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, abstract) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  filter(!word %in% custom_stop_words) %>%
  filter(str_detect(word, "^[a-z]+$"))

tfidf_total <- tidy_reg %>%
  count(doc_number, word) %>%
  bind_tf_idf(term = word, document = doc_number, n = n) %>%
  group_by(doc_number) %>%
  summarise(tfidf_total = sum(tf_idf), .groups = "drop")

reg_df <- reg_base %>%
  left_join(topic_wide, by = "doc_number") %>%
  left_join(tfidf_total, by = "doc_number") %>%
  mutate(tfidf_total = replace_na(tfidf_total, 0)) %>%
  drop_na(citations, altmetric, abstract_length, year, journal)

ggplot(reg_df, aes(citations)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  labs(
    title = "Citation counts",
    x = "Citations",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
#regression model
set.seed(10)

idx <- createDataPartition(reg_df$citations, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

train_reg <- reg_df[idx, ]
test_reg  <- reg_df[-idx, ]

lm_cit <- lm(
  citations ~ abstract_length + year + journal + altmetric + tfidf_total +
    topic_1 + topic_2 + topic_3 + topic_4 + topic_5,
  data = train_reg
)

pred_cit_te <- predict(lm_cit, newdata = test_reg)
pred_cit_te <- ifelse(pred_cit_te < 0, 0, pred_cit_te)

rmse_cit <- RMSE(pred_cit_te, test_reg$citations)
r2_cit   <- R2(pred_cit_te, test_reg$citations)


rmse_cit
r2_cit


```

```{r}
#account for skewness
#log + 1

lm_log <- lm(
  log(citations + 1) ~ abstract_length + year + journal + altmetric + tfidf_total +
    topic_1 + topic_2 + topic_3 + topic_4 + topic_5,
  data = train_reg
)

pred_log_te <- exp(predict(lm_log, newdata = test_reg)) - 1
pred_log_te <- ifelse(pred_log_te < 0, 0, pred_log_te)


rmse_log <- RMSE(pred_log_te, test_reg$citations)
r2_log <- R2(pred_log_te, test_reg$citations)


rmse_log
r2_log

```


```{r}
# binary label
train_bin <- train_reg %>% mutate(cited = factor(ifelse(citations > 0, "Yes", "No")))
test_bin  <- test_reg  %>% mutate(cited = factor(ifelse(citations > 0, "Yes", "No"),
                                                 levels = levels(train_bin$cited)))

logit_cited <- glm(
  cited ~ abstract_length + year + journal + altmetric + tfidf_total +
    topic_1 + topic_2 + topic_3 + topic_4 + topic_5,
  data = train_bin,
  family = binomial
)

prob_test <- predict(logit_cited, newdata = test_bin, type = "response")

pred_test <- factor(ifelse(prob_test > 0.5, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))

confusionMatrix(pred_test, test_bin$cited, positive = "Yes")


roc_obj <- roc(test_bin$cited, prob_test, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
auc(roc_obj)
plot(
  roc_obj,
  xlim = c(1, 0),
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  main = "ROC: predicting whether a paper is cited",
  legacy.axes = TRUE
)



```

```{r}
train_pos <- train_reg %>% filter(citations > 0)
test_pos  <- test_reg  %>% filter(citations > 0)

lm_pos <- lm(
  log(citations) ~ abstract_length + year + journal + altmetric + tfidf_total +
    topic_1 + topic_2 + topic_3 + topic_4 + topic_5,
  data = train_pos
)

pred_log <- predict(lm_pos, newdata = test_pos)
pred_cit <- pmax(0, exp(pred_log))

RMSE(pred_cit, test_pos$citations)
R2(pred_cit, test_pos$citations)
mean(abs(pred_cit - test_pos$citations))

```
